categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the power semiconductor sector, focusing on the design, research, development, production, and sales of IGBT, FRD power semiconductor chips, discrete devices, and modules. Its products serve industries such as industrial control, new energy vehicles, new energy power generation, energy storage, and consumer electronics. The company also provides power semiconductor device solutions and has a full product line covering chips, discrete devices, and modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced trench gate and field-stop structures, virtual cell technology, reverse conduction IGBT, micro-trench IGBT, soft recovery diode chips, high-efficiency rectifier diode chips, high-voltage MOS chips, silver sintering technology for third-generation semiconductors, low parasitic parameter module wiring, ultrasonic bonding technology, and planar transfer molding for double-sided/single-sided water cooling. The company employs fabless manufacturing for chips, outsourcing wafer fabrication to foundries, while modules are produced in-house with advanced packaging and testing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in industrial control (e.g., inverters, servo motors, UPS), new energy vehicles (electric control systems, charging piles), new energy power generation (photovoltaic inverters, wind power converters), energy storage, and consumer electronics sectors. The company has strategic partnerships with leading industrial and automotive companies and supplies to major domestic and international clients including Hitachi Energy, Siemens, and Eaton.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It is expanding its market presence globally, supplying products and services to international industrial giants and targeting global markets in new energy and industrial automation sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on chip design and module packaging, outsourcing wafer fabrication to foundries (fabless model), and providing integrated power semiconductor solutions to end customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing core technologies in IGBT, SiC, and GaN semiconductors, enhancing product competitiveness, and expanding market penetration in new energy vehicles, new energy power generation, and industrial control. The company emphasizes R&D investment, with 8.24% of revenue allocated to R&D in 2024, focusing on high-voltage SiC MOSFETs, automotive-grade modules, and innovative packaging technologies. It also aims to build a diversified technology system integrating silicon-based and wide bandgap semiconductors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of power semiconductor chips, discrete devices, and modules. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, and also earns income from technical service fees during product development phases. It engages in contract manufacturing and provides customized solutions to strategic customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders such as Infineon, STMicroelectronics, ON Semiconductor, Mitsubishi Electric, and Fuji Electric. It positions itself as a leading domestic power semiconductor enterprise with growing capabilities in mid-to-high-end markets and is recognized for its technological innovation and product quality. It is actively participating in the domestic substitution of imported power semiconductors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, a decrease of 11.52% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 14.47 million. Despite short-term pressures, the company showed resilience with a 9.13% revenue growth in the second half of 2024. R&D expenses increased to RMB 109.76 million, accounting for 8.24% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 2.6 billion with a 4.52% increase from the previous year. The company is in a growth phase with strategic investments in technology and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced technology platform, including proprietary chip designs and module packaging technologies that deliver high performance, reliability, and efficiency. Its products are tailored for demanding applications in new energy vehicles, renewable energy, and industrial automation, offering customers high power density, thermal stability, and cost-effectiveness. The company’s integrated product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities provide customers with comprehensive, customized power semiconductor solutions, supporting their innovation and sustainability goals.
